lines.text: In late twenty twenty-two, Chat G P T arrived.
lines.caption: In late 2022, ChatGPT arrived.

lines.text: You typed a message, and it wrote back.
lines.caption: You typed a message, and it wrote back.

lines.text: It could talk, and that was all.
lines.caption: It could talk, and that was all.

lines.text: Now there are AI agents that do things.
lines.caption: Now there are AI agents that do things.

lines.text: Give one a bug in some code, and it reads the files, runs the tests that check the code, and fixes the bug.
lines.caption: Give one a bug in some code, and it reads the files, runs the tests that check the code, and fixes the bug.

lines.text: Underneath, it's the same kind of model as the one in the chat.
lines.caption: Underneath, it's the same kind of model as the one in the chat.

lines.text: And a model like that only writes text.
lines.caption: And a model like that only writes text.

lines.text: So what sits in between?
lines.caption: So what sits in between?

lines.text: How do you get from a model that writes text, to an agent that fixes a bug?
lines.caption: How do you get from a model that writes text, to an agent that fixes a bug?

lines.text: Start with the model.
lines.caption: Start with the model.

lines.text: It's called an L L M, a large language model, and it does one thing: it predicts the next word, or sometimes a piece of a word.
lines.caption: It's called an LLM, a large language model, and it does one thing: it predicts the next word, or sometimes a piece of a word.

lines.text: Give a small, freely available model the words "I made a cup of".
lines.caption: Give a small, freely available model the words "I made a cup of".

lines.text: It gives every word it knows a probability.
lines.caption: It gives every word it knows a probability.

lines.text: "Tea" gets thirty-one percent.
lines.caption: "Tea" gets thirty-one percent.

lines.text: "Coffee", nineteen.
lines.caption: "Coffee", nineteen.

lines.text: Everything else is far behind.
lines.caption: Everything else is far behind.

lines.text: Pick one of the likely words, and add it to the text.
lines.caption: Pick one of the likely words, and add it to the text.

lines.text: Then predict again: "tea", then "and", then "I".
lines.caption: Then predict again: "tea", then "and", then "I".

lines.text: Over and over, one word at a time.
lines.caption: Over and over, one word at a time.

lines.text: That's all writing is, for an L L M.
lines.caption: That's all writing is, for an LLM.

lines.text: It works only from the text in front of it.
lines.caption: It works only from the text in front of it.

lines.text: That text is called its context.
lines.caption: That text is called its context.

lines.text: The model keeps no memory from one use to the next.
lines.caption: The model keeps no memory from one use to the next.

lines.text: So keep two facts in mind.
lines.caption: So keep two facts in mind.

lines.text: What comes out of an L L M is text.
lines.caption: What comes out of an LLM is text.

lines.text: It learned a lot in training.
lines.caption: It learned a lot in training.

lines.text: But about your task, it knows only what's in its context.
lines.caption: But about your task, it knows only what's in its context.

lines.text: Here's a task.
lines.caption: Here's a task.

lines.text: A small shop's billing code stops with an error: no price for "gadget".
lines.caption: A small shop's billing code stops with an error: no price for "gadget".

lines.text: You might picture the model reaching into the files itself.
lines.caption: You might picture the model reaching into the files itself.

lines.text: So ask a model on its own to fix it: not the small one, but a large model, like the ones behind chat assistants.
lines.caption: So ask a model on its own to fix it: not the small one, but a large model, like the ones behind chat assistants.

lines.text: In one try, it wrote that it would explore the project, and even wrote out a request to run a command.
lines.caption: In one try, it wrote that it would explore the project, and even wrote out a request to run a command.

lines.text: But nothing was there to carry it out, and the tests still failed.
lines.caption: But nothing was there to carry it out, and the tests still failed.

lines.text: Text on its own doesn't do anything.
lines.caption: Text on its own doesn't do anything.

lines.text: So put a program next to the model, to watch what it writes.
lines.caption: So put a program next to the model, to watch what it writes.

lines.text: Then give the model a format for requests, described at the top of its context.
lines.caption: Then give the model a format for requests, described at the top of its context.

lines.text: A line that starts "search:", then some words.
lines.caption: A line that starts "search:", then some words.

lines.text: Or "open file:", then a file name.
lines.caption: Or "open file:", then a file name.

lines.text: Real agents use a stricter format, but the idea is the same.
lines.caption: Real agents use a stricter format, but the idea is the same.

lines.text: Now the model writes a line: search, "no price for".
lines.caption: Now the model writes a line: search, "no price for".

lines.text: The program spots the request, and searches the project's files for those words.
lines.caption: The program spots the request, and searches the project's files for those words.

lines.text: Each thing the program can do for the model is called a tool: search, open a file, edit a file, run the tests.
lines.caption: Each thing the program can do for the model is called a tool: search, open a file, edit a file, run the tests.

lines.text: Notice who did the searching.
lines.caption: Notice who did the searching.

lines.text: The model only wrote a line of text.
lines.caption: The model only wrote a line of text.

lines.text: The program did the work.
lines.caption: The program did the work.

lines.text: The search found something.
lines.caption: The search found something.

lines.text: But the model can't see it.
lines.caption: But the model can't see it.

lines.text: Remember: it knows only what's in its context.
lines.caption: Remember: it knows only what's in its context.

lines.text: So the program pastes the result into the context.
lines.caption: So the program pastes the result into the context.

lines.text: One match: line eight of a file called prices dot P Y.
lines.caption: One match: line eight of a file called prices.py.

lines.text: Then it runs the model again, on the whole context, because the model remembers nothing.
lines.caption: Then it runs the model again, on the whole context, because the model remembers nothing.

lines.text: Now the model continues with the result in view.
lines.caption: Now the model continues with the result in view.

lines.text: It knows something it couldn't have known before: where the error comes from.
lines.caption: It knows something it couldn't have known before: where the error comes from.

lines.text: So it writes its next request: open that file.
lines.caption: So it writes its next request: open that file.

lines.text: You've probably seen this already.
lines.caption: You've probably seen this already.

lines.text: In twenty twenty-three, the popular chat assistants started searching the web.
lines.caption: In 2023, the popular chat assistants started searching the web.

lines.text: It's the same trick.
lines.caption: It's the same trick.

lines.text: The model writes a search, a program runs it, and the results are pasted into the context.
lines.caption: The model writes a search, a program runs it, and the results are pasted into the context.

lines.text: Then the model answers, with those pages in view.
lines.caption: Then the model answers, with those pages in view.

lines.text: One step won't fix a bug.
lines.caption: One step won't fix a bug.

lines.text: So repeat.
lines.caption: So repeat.

lines.text: The model writes a request, the program carries it out, and the result goes into the context.
lines.caption: The model writes a request, the program carries it out, and the result goes into the context.

lines.text: Then again.
lines.caption: Then again.

lines.text: This goes on until the model writes a reply with no request in it.
lines.caption: This goes on until the model writes a reply with no request in it.

lines.text: That's its answer, and the loop stops.
lines.caption: That's its answer, and the loop stops.

lines.text: A model working in a loop like this, using tools, is called an agent.
lines.caption: A model working in a loop like this, using tools, is called an agent.

lines.text: Here's how the whole run went.
lines.caption: Here's how the whole run went.

lines.text: After the search and the file you've seen, it searches for where that code is used, and opens that file too.
lines.caption: After the search and the file you've seen, it searches for where that code is used, and opens that file too.

lines.text: The price list spells it "Gadget", with a capital G.
lines.caption: The price list spells it "Gadget", with a capital G.

lines.text: So it edits the lookup: now "gadget" finds "Gadget".
lines.caption: So it edits the lookup: now "gadget" finds "Gadget".

lines.text: Then it runs the tests.
lines.caption: Then it runs the tests.

lines.text: They fail.
lines.caption: They fail.

lines.text: Ben's bill should come to thirty-seven.
lines.caption: Ben's bill should come to thirty-seven.

lines.text: It comes to thirty-nine fifty.
lines.caption: It comes to thirty-nine fifty.

lines.text: That failure goes into the context, like any other result, and it changes the next step.
lines.caption: That failure goes into the context, like any other result, and it changes the next step.

lines.text: The model looks at the test and at Ben's orders, and finds a second mistake.
lines.caption: The model looks at the test and at Ben's orders, and finds a second mistake.

lines.text: The bulk discount only kicked in at eleven items.
lines.caption: The bulk discount only kicked in at eleven items.

lines.text: It should start at ten.
lines.caption: It should start at ten.

lines.text: It edits that, and runs the tests again.
lines.caption: It edits that, and runs the tests again.

lines.text: This time they pass.
lines.caption: This time they pass.

lines.text: It writes its answer, and the loop stops.
lines.caption: It writes its answer, and the loop stops.

lines.text: That was twelve requests.
lines.caption: That was twelve requests.

lines.text: Nobody wrote them down in advance.
lines.caption: Nobody wrote them down in advance.

lines.text: Each one followed from the results before it.
lines.caption: Each one followed from the results before it.

lines.text: If the loop is that simple, why did agents only start working recently?
lines.caption: If the loop is that simple, why did agents only start working recently?

lines.text: People tried, in twenty twenty-three.
lines.caption: People tried, in 2023.

lines.text: They ran models in loops like this one, and the loops often got stuck, going round in circles.
lines.caption: They ran models in loops like this one, and the loops often got stuck, going round in circles.

lines.text: Part of the problem is that small mistakes add up.
lines.caption: Part of the problem is that small mistakes add up.

lines.text: Say each step goes right ninety-five times in a hundred, whatever happened before, and nothing catches a mistake.
lines.caption: Say each step goes right ninety-five times in a hundred, whatever happened before, and nothing catches a mistake.

lines.text: Start a hundred runs.
lines.caption: Start a hundred runs.

lines.text: About ninety-five get the first step right.
lines.caption: About ninety-five get the first step right.

lines.text: Of those, ninety-five percent get the second step right too: about ninety.
lines.caption: Of those, ninety-five percent get the second step right too: about ninety.

lines.text: Every step keeps ninety-five percent of the runs still on track.
lines.caption: Every step keeps ninety-five percent of the runs still on track.

lines.text: After twenty steps, that's about thirty-six of the hundred.
lines.caption: After twenty steps, that's about thirty-six of the hundred.

lines.text: About a third.
lines.caption: About a third.

lines.text: Three things changed.
lines.caption: Three things changed.

lines.text: First, models were trained to work in this loop, so each step became more reliable.
lines.caption: First, models were trained to work in this loop, so each step became more reliable.

lines.text: Suppose that lifts each step to ninety-nine in a hundred.
lines.caption: Suppose that lifts each step to ninety-nine in a hundred.

lines.text: Then about eighty-two of the hundred runs get all twenty steps right: about four in five.
lines.caption: Then about eighty-two of the hundred runs get all twenty steps right: about four in five.

lines.text: Second, tasks like coding come with feedback.
lines.caption: Second, tasks like coding come with feedback.

lines.text: A failing test catches a mistake, as it caught the discount, and the next step can fix it.
lines.caption: A failing test catches a mistake, as it caught the discount, and the next step can fix it.

lines.text: Third, agents find what they need by searching, step by step, as that run did.
lines.caption: Third, agents find what they need by searching, step by step, as that run did.

lines.text: Claude Code, a coding agent, works that way.
lines.caption: Claude Code, a coding agent, works that way.

lines.text: Its developers first tried building an index of the code in advance.
lines.caption: Its developers first tried building an index of the code in advance.

lines.text: But code keeps changing, and an index goes out of date.
lines.caption: But code keeps changing, and an index goes out of date.

lines.text: They've said searching worked better.
lines.caption: They've said searching worked better.

lines.text: Now put names on the whole picture.
lines.caption: Now put names on the whole picture.

lines.text: The L L M is the model.
lines.caption: The LLM is the model.

lines.text: Everything around it is called the harness.
lines.caption: Everything around it is called the harness.

lines.text: The harness writes the starting instructions, with the request format.
lines.caption: The harness writes the starting instructions, with the request format.

lines.text: It holds the tools, and the program that carries out each request, and it runs the loop.
lines.caption: It holds the tools, and the program that carries out each request, and it runs the loop.

lines.text: A real harness does two more things.
lines.caption: A real harness does two more things.

lines.text: Before an edit, like the one to the price lookup, it can check permission, sometimes by asking you.
lines.caption: Before an edit, like the one to the price lookup, it can check permission, sometimes by asking you.

lines.text: And every result makes the context longer, but a context can only hold so much.
lines.caption: And every result makes the context longer, but a context can only hold so much.

lines.text: When it fills up, the harness trims it, by dropping old results or summarizing older steps.
lines.caption: When it fills up, the harness trims it, by dropping old results or summarizing older steps.

lines.text: So an agent is an L L M plus a harness.
lines.caption: So an agent is an LLM plus a harness.

lines.text: That's five words to keep: L L M, context, tool, harness, and agent.
lines.caption: That's five words to keep: LLM, context, tool, harness, and agent.

lines.text: So, how do you get from a model that only writes text to an agent that fixes a bug?
lines.caption: So, how do you get from a model that only writes text to an agent that fixes a bug?

lines.text: The model still does one thing.
lines.caption: The model still does one thing.

lines.text: It predicts the next word, one at a time.
lines.caption: It predicts the next word, one at a time.

lines.text: The harness turns some of that text into actions, and pastes the results back into the context.
lines.caption: The harness turns some of that text into actions, and pastes the results back into the context.

lines.text: And the loop turns single steps into a whole job.
lines.caption: And the loop turns single steps into a whole job.

lines.text: Chat G P T in twenty twenty-two could only talk.
lines.caption: ChatGPT in 2022 could only talk.

lines.text: An agent is still talking.
lines.caption: An agent is still talking.

lines.text: The difference is the harness: a program that listens to what the model writes, and acts on it.
lines.caption: The difference is the harness: a program that listens to what the model writes, and acts on it.
